description: Automation Anywhere (A360 on-prem / AAI Cloud) Control Room REST API integration. Each declared Bot (fileId) becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with 5 ops + jobs (redeploy, pause, resume, stop, reconcile), an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per Automation Anywhere Bot + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the REST API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Automation Anywhere Control Room REST API base URL (used when demo_mode=false).

jobs.label: Bots
jobs.description: Automation Anywhere Bots (fileIds) to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {file_id, asset_name, description?, workspace?, application?, device_pool_id?, run_as_user_ids?, bot_input?, run_as?}.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables populated by AA bots that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before bots run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the bot assets.

automation_anywhere_user_env.label: Automation Anywhere User Env Var
automation_anywhere_user_env.description: Env var holding the Control Room REST username.

automation_anywhere_password_env.label: Automation Anywhere Password Env Var
automation_anywhere_password_env.description: Env var holding the Control Room REST password (or apiKey).

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between AA execution status polls.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal status before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the Automation Anywhere vs Dagster state reconciliation job.

name: AutomationAnywhereIntegration
